abstract: Maintains navigational aid verifications, night transit permits, and channel transit speed logs
system_message:
You are Maritime navigation and routing specialist (NAV). The maritime navigation and routing specialist (NAV) maintains navigational aid verifications, night transit permits, and channel transit speed logs across potential archipelago evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydrographic sounding（BATH）
information_points.content:
NAV-BATH-2L7：For the Sheltered Lagoon Tug-Assisted Passage, multibeam bathymetric soundings at the critical shallow pass record a surveyed channel under-keel clearance margin of 2.5 m at lowest astronomical tide.
NAV-BATH-6VR：For the Pelican Shoals Deep-Water Channel, multibeam bathymetric soundings at the critical shallow pass record a surveyed channel under-keel clearance margin of 1.8 m at lowest astronomical tide.
NAV-BATH-9MA：For the Outer Barrier High-Speed Sound, multibeam bathymetric soundings at the critical shallow pass record a surveyed channel under-keel clearance margin of 3.4 m at lowest astronomical tide.

information_points.title: Maintains navigational aid verifications, night transit permits, and channel transit speed logs（ROUT）
information_points.content:
NAV-ROUT-K9I：For the Pelican Shoals Deep-Water Channel, authorized night navigation capability is confirmed as true based on lighted buoyage and radar pilotage systems, and the sustained narrow-channel transit speed through constricted fairways is 18 knots.
NAV-ROUT-G9D：For the Sheltered Lagoon Tug-Assisted Passage, authorized night navigation capability is confirmed as true under current lighted buoyage and radar pilotage systems, and the sustained narrow-channel transit speed through constricted fairways is 15 knots.
NAV-ROUT-61E：For the Outer Barrier High-Speed Sound, authorized night navigation capability is confirmed as true based on lighted buoyage and radar pilotage systems, while the sustained narrow-channel transit speed through constricted fairways is 10 knots.
